details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1290-1330 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The status token is interpolated into the HTML comment marker without validation against the documented enum.
  WHY: A future caller could pass a value containing `-->`, which would break the `<!-- status:... -->` contract and corrupt downstream parsing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4878-4931 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The validation-failure recovery path returns after switching back to `in_progress` without refreshing the pinned completion-status comment.
  WHY: Operators see stale failed/ready state during the recovery window until a later poll tick rewrites the comment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10059-10065 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_completion_status_text` is derived only from `WAVE_STATUS`, not the live `.status` in `STATE_FILE`.
  WHY: During validation recovery it can display `ready` while the project is actually back in `in_progress`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1278-1282 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `persist_completion_status_comment_state` returns success when its preconditions fail.
  WHY: Silent skips hide missing persistence of the idempotency metadata and make callers unable to distinguish success from a no-op.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10043-10132 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` mutation is not guaranteed to be flushed back to the issue comment chain because no state-changed path is forced after the write.
  WHY: If no other mutation happens in that tick, the alert-sent flag can be lost on the next poll and the CRITICAL Telegram alert can repeat.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10043-10059 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The alert-flag update uses a non-atomic read-modify-write pattern without locking.
  WHY: Two concurrent pollers can both observe `false` and both send the once-per-project CRITICAL alert.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10005-10037 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `implementation-failed` issues are excluded from the pending-merge list but still included in the failed-lines list.
  WHY: The same issue can appear twice in the pinned comment with conflicting framing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4774-4796 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `PROJECT_COMPLETE` preflight only blocks when the variable is set and not `"true"`, so an unset value falls through.
  WHY: Validation can be dispatched prematurely when `PROJECT_COMPLETE` was never initialized or the wave-status path failed silently.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1347-1350 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The hash-match early-return path skips `persist_completion_status_comment_state`.
  WHY: `COMPLETION_STATUS_STATE_CHANGED` stays `false`, so the state/comment chain may not be flushed or re-posted when needed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1285-1291 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `persist_completion_status_comment_state` sets `COMPLETION_STATUS_STATE_CHANGED="true"` even when the values being written are identical to what is already stored.
  WHY: Every idempotent match still triggers `post_state_comment`, causing unnecessary comment-chain churn.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1376-1399,4881-4885,4926-4932,5015-5019,10107 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `update_completion_status_comment` failures are suppressed with `|| true` at every call site.
  WHY: Transient PATCH/POST failures leave the pinned comment stale for that tick with no caller-visible failure or retry pressure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1378-1410 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A successful PATCH/POST response can still leave `response_id` empty and skip persistence.
  WHY: The next cycle lacks `completion_status_comment_id`, so the helper can fall back to duplicate POSTs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1354-1355 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `state_hash` and `state_comment_id` are read from `STATE_FILE` without validating they are well-formed.
  WHY: Malformed values can corrupt comparisons or API calls.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1299-1332 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The idempotency check compares stored hash/body values without validating they are well-formed.
  WHY: Corrupted or empty values can make the helper incorrectly skip needed updates or retry forever.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1331 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: A temporary payload file is created and deleted on every call to `update_completion_status_comment`.
  WHY: This adds avoidable filesystem I/O on the hot poll path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1281-1282 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `comment_id` is passed through `--argjson` even though the value may be empty or invalid JSON.
  WHY: `jq` can fail or produce unexpected output, potentially corrupting the state-file write.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10001-10088 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The completion-status block re-parses the same `WAVE_STATUS` JSON with many separate `jq` invocations.
  WHY: Each poll tick spawns extra subprocesses and re-parses the same blob on the hot path.
- agents.md:129-196 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new completion-status marker/helper documentation is not reflected in the stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream tooling that relies on the documented prefix list will miss the new completion-status events.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10133-10137 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_csc_pending_lines` and `_csc_failed_lines` are not unset after use.
  WHY: The cycle-scope locals linger past the cleanup phase instead of following the surrounding pattern.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1330 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `status` parameter is interpolated directly into the HTML comment marker without validation.
  WHY: A future caller passing a value containing `-->` would break the `<!-- status:... -->` structure and corrupt downstream parsing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4886-4910 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The validation-failure recovery branch returns without calling `update_completion_status_comment`.
  WHY: The pinned completion-status comment stays stale while the project is back in recovery until the next poll tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10059-10065 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_completion_status_text` is derived purely from `WAVE_STATUS` fields and never consults the live `.status` in `STATE_FILE`.
  WHY: A recovery cycle can still render `State: ready` even though the project is actually `in_progress`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1278-1281 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `persist_completion_status_comment_state` returns 0 when `STATE_FILE` is missing, `comment_id` is invalid, or `body_hash` is empty.
  WHY: Callers cannot distinguish a successful persist from a silent no-op, so metadata loss is masked.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10112-10132 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The alert-sent write path can leave `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` unpersisted because no state-changed flag is forced after the mutation.
  WHY: If that is the only mutation in the tick, the alert flag can be lost and the one-time Telegram alert can fire again later.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10112-10122 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` read-then-write path is non-atomic and has no locking.
  WHY: Two concurrent pollers could both read `false`, both send the CRITICAL alert, and race on the flag update.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4881-4885,4926-4932,5015-5019,10107 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Every `update_completion_status_comment` call site suppresses failures with `|| true`.
  WHY: GitHub API or payload failures leave the comment stale for a tick with no programmatic back-pressure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1378-1410 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: On PATCH/POST success, `response_id` can still be empty and the function can return without persisting the new comment ID.
  WHY: The next cycle then lacks `completion_status_comment_id` and may POST a duplicate pinned comment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10044-10088 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The completion-status body construction makes several separate `jq` calls against the same `WAVE_STATUS` JSON blob.
  WHY: This adds extra subprocess overhead on the 5-minute poll path by re-parsing the same payload repeatedly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: Empty or malformed values can flow into hash comparisons or API calls and produce invalid behavior.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4878-4931 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The validation-failure recovery path returns without calling `update_completion_status_comment`.
  WHY: The pinned status stays stale while the project is back in `in_progress` recovery until the next poll tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10043-10059 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` is updated in `STATE_FILE` but no `CHANGED` flag is set, so `post_state_comment` is not guaranteed to persist it.
  WHY: A fresh runner can lose the alert-sent flag on the next cycle, allowing the same CRITICAL alert to fire again.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10005-10037 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `implementation-failed` issues are excluded from pending-merge lines but still included in failed-lines.
  WHY: The same issue can appear twice with conflicting framing in the completion-status comment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4774-4796 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `PROJECT_COMPLETE` preflight only blocks when the variable is set and not `"true"`.
  WHY: An unset value is treated as not gated, so validation can be dispatched prematurely for an incomplete project.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10043-10048 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The alert-flag write uses a non-atomic read-modify-write pattern without locking or compare-and-swap.
  WHY: Two concurrent pollers can both read `false`, both send the CRITICAL alert, and then race on the write.
